path.isekai_mahou.hollowfied.desc: The Shinigami who lost to their own Inner Hollow. The mask covered the face, the hole opened in the chest and the soul turned into hunger. Devour souls to evolve from Hollow to Arrancar.
path.isekai_mahou.hollowfied.system.desc: Everything strong you kill becomes a Soul. Souls evolve your body (Hollow → Gillian → Adjuchas → Vasto Lorde → Arrancar) and pay for Regeneration. Go too long without devouring and the hunger weakens you.
path.isekai_mahou.hollowfied.bonus: Claws: empty-hand punches tear (+2 damage, +1 per stage). Passive Hierro from Vasto Lorde on. Hueco Mundo Hollows don't attack you (unless you attack them).
path.isekai_mahou.hollowfied.locked: Secret class: a Shinigami who loses to the Inner Hollow in the Inner World (or accepts it) becomes a Hollow.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollowfied_cero.desc: (Legacy) Cero is now an INNATE TECHNIQUE: hold the Hollow Instinct key (R). This glyph only exists for old spells and fires a fully charged Cero.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollowfied_bala.desc: (Legacy) Bala is now an innate technique: tap Hollow Instinct (R). This glyph only exists for old spells.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollowfied_pesquisa.d: (Legacy) Pesquisa is now an innate technique: sneak + tap Hollow Instinct, or the Hollow Wheel (H). Old spells only.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollowfied_regen.desc: (Legacy) Regeneration is now an innate technique, on the Hollow Wheel (H). Old spells only.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollowfied_hierro.des: (Legacy) Hierro is now passive and is concentrated via the Hollow Wheel (H). Old spells only.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollowfied_sonido.des: (Legacy) Sonído is now an innate technique: sprint + Hollow Instinct (R). Old spells only.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollowfied_garganta.d: (Legacy) Garganta is now an innate technique, on the Hollow Wheel (H). Old spells only.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollowfied_gran_rey_c: (Legacy) Gran Rey Cero is now an innate technique: sneak + hold Hollow Instinct (R). Old spells only.
(Legacy) Descorrer is now an innate technique, on the Hollow Wheel (H). Old spells only.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollowfied_resurrecci: (Legacy) Resurrección is now an innate technique, on the Hollow Wheel (H), with full invocation and transformation. Old spells only.
hollow.isekai_mahou.rank_tip.0: Hunger is born: Cero, Bala, Pesquisa and Regeneration — all on the Hollow Instinct key (R) and the Hollow Wheel (H).
hollow.isekai_mahou.rank_tip.1: The body swells with souls: Hierro (passive −10%, can be concentrated) and the "On Devouring a Soul" trigger.
hollow.isekai_mahou.rank_tip.2: The clever beast: Sonído, Garganta and the "Fused Cero" augment. Bone pauldrons.
hollow.isekai_mahou.rank_tip.3: The peak of Hollows: long horns, Gran Rey Cero, Negación, Hierro −25% and the black-red Cero.
hollow.isekai_mahou.rank_tip.4: The mask breaks: human form, Resurrección, Descorrer and — when released — the Cero Oscuras.
hollow.isekai_mahou.release.pantera.desc: The hunting beast: Speed III, Strength II and high jumps. Your hits LAUNCH Desgarrón: three blue claw marks that fly 20 blocks forward and cut everyone in their path (once every 1.5 s). Hits ×1.4.
hollow.isekai_mahou.release.murcielago.d: Black wings: FLIGHT, slow falling and night vision. The Cero becomes the Lightning Lance (wider, ×1.5) that ends in a GIANT explosion with a pillar of light and a shockwave. Hits ×1.25.
hollow.isekai_mahou.release.serpiente.de: Scales and venom: Regeneration II, Resistance II and every hit poisons. A long tail sweeps the ground behind you. Hits ×1.15.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.arrancar_rea: The mask creaks and starts to crack... You can become an ARRANCAR. Choose your Resurrección (Hollow tab in the B menu).
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.blade_lost: The zanpakutō, bound to your Shinigami soul, crumbles into black dust.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.blade_reject: The Shinigami blade crumbles in the Hollow's hands.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.scene_defeat: You lost... and the Inner Hollow does not give back what it takes.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.scene_accept: You open your arms. The Inner Hollow laughs — and comes in.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.became_annou: A roar tears the sky: %s became a HOLLOW.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.became_tip.1: • Your class is now Hollow. Level, Circle and glyphs stay; the zanpakutō is gone.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.became_tip.2: • Devour SOULS by killing strong creatures, players and Hollows: they make you evolve (Hollow tab in the B menu).
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.became_tip.3: • 20 minutes without devouring weakens you. Regeneration (Hollow Wheel) costs Souls.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.became_tip.4: • Your techniques are INNATE: Hollow Instinct key (default R) — tap = Bala, hold = Cero, sneaking = Pesquisa, sprinting = Sonído.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.hungry: The hunger for souls starts gnawing at you... (Weakness, techniques −20%)
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.starving: STARVING! Your body starts to fall apart. Devour a soul soon! (Weakness II, Hunger, techniques −40%)
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.release_end: The released form crumbles — the body pays the price.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.release_none: You don't have a Resurrección yet (become an Arrancar and choose yours).
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.regen_hunger: No Souls: the flesh closes with your hunger.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.regen_nothin: No Souls and too hungry to regenerate.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.hierro: Hierro: your skin turns to iron.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.descorrer_bl: No room to step through there.
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.choice.title: The Inner Hollow
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.choice.text:
The mask of your Inner Hollow grins. "King or horse, partner? Fight me and prove it — or let me in."

FIGHT: winning teaches the Hollow Mask and the Cero. But if you DIE in this fight, the Hollow takes your body and you become a Hollow.

ACCEPT: you give yourself to it now.
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.choice.warn: This is PERMANENT. You stop being a Shinigami and become the HOLLOW class: the zanpakutō crumbles, the Zanpakutō Path ends and you live by devouring souls. Level, Circle and glyphs stay.
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.release.title: Resurrección
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.release.sub: The mask breaks. Choose ONCE the form of your sealed power.
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.origin.1: Taken by the Inner Hollow after losing the fight (was a rank %s Shinigami; day %s).
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.origin.2: Accepted the inner hollow (was a rank %s Shinigami; day %s).
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.guide.1: Kill strong creatures, players and Hollows to devour Souls. Animals have no soul worth eating.
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.guide.2: Bosses are worth a lot: 60 souls or more, and they count for evolution.
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.guide.3: 20 min without devouring: hungry (techniques −20%). 40 min: starving and losing Souls.
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.guide.4: Regeneration (Hollow Wheel) heals a lot but costs 5 Souls. Hierro is passive and grows with your body.
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.guide.5: Hueco Mundo Hollows recognize one of their own: they don't attack unless you do. Garganta takes you there.
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.guide.6: As an Arrancar the mask breaks: choose your Resurrección (once) and release it from the Hollow Wheel.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.cero.desc: Energy gathers in the mask's mouth (at the fingertips, as an Arrancar) and fires as a beam that pierces EVERY enemy and explodes at the end. The longer you hold, the thicker, farther and stronger. Its color is your body's: crimson, scarlet, black-red, and your archetype's as an Arrancar. Released Murciélago: becomes the Lanza del Relámpago. Cost: 5–12% Vigor.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.cero.how: Hold [Hollow Instinct] and release (min charge 0.5 s, full 1.8 s).
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.bala.desc: Reiatsu punched into an instant shot, 20× faster than a Cero and much weaker: up to 24 blocks, small knockback. Made to spam: 4 shots per second. Cost: 1.2% Vigor per shot.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.gran_rey_cero.d: A Cero mixed with your own blood (costs 2 health): a COLOSSAL 64-block beam that goes through walls and shakes the ground. From Vasto Lorde on; while released (Resurrección) it charges faster, costs less and hits ×1.5. Cost: 30% Vigor (22% released). Cooldown 45 s (30 s).
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.gran_rey_cero.h: Sneaking: hold [Hollow Instinct] 1.5 s (1 s released) and release.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.cero_oscuras.de: RELEASED Arrancar only: the Cero turns BLACK, edged with your archetype's color. Goes through walls, withers whatever it touches and leaves a void at the end that pulses 3 times. Cost: 35% Vigor. Cooldown 60 s.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.cero_oscuras.ho: Released: hold the Cero until the charge turns dark (2.2 s) and release.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.sonido.desc: The Hollow's step: vanish with a snap and reappear up to 10 blocks ahead (+2 per stage), leaving an afterimage. Aiming at an enemy, you appear BEHIND it, facing it. Up to 3 steps in a row; then 2.5 s cooldown. Cost: 3% Vigor per step.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.pesquisa.desc: The Hollow's sense: a pulse reveals everything alive within 32 blocks, through walls, for 10 s. Hostiles in red, players in white, strong presences in black. Cost: 4% Vigor.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.pesquisa.how: Sneaking: tap [Hollow Instinct] — or use the Hollow Wheel.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.regen.desc: The flesh closes at once: heals 30% health (40% from Vasto Lorde on) and clears fire, poison and wither. Costs 5 Souls; without Souls, costs hunger. Cooldown 15 s.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.hierro.desc: Iron skin. PASSIVE, grows with your body: −10% damage (Gillian), −15% (Adjuchas), −25% (Vasto Lorde), −30% (Arrancar). Concentrated: −30% for 10 s, or −50% and no knockback for 8 s from Vasto Lorde on. Cost: 8% Vigor.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.hierro.how: Always passive; concentrate via the Hollow Wheel.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.garganta.desc: Sink your claws into the air and TEAR the sky (1.5 s): a black toothed maw opens and leads to the Hollow World — or back, if you are already there. Cost: 15% Vigor. Cooldown 30 s (plus the Hollow World shortcut cooldown).
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.negacion.desc: The Hollows' escape: a golden pillar of light descends on you for 3 s — NOTHING touches you (and you can't attack), pursuers lose their target and, when the light fades, it carries you up to 20 blocks away from the nearest enemy. Cost: 20% Vigor. Cooldown 3 min.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.descorrer.desc: The Arrancar opens a rift in space and steps through: reappears where you look, up to 40 blocks. Cost: 10% Vigor. Cooldown 8 s.
hollow_tech.isekai_mahou.resurreccion.de: The Arrancar's TRANSFORMATION: the release command, a pillar of Reiatsu in your archetype's color rises for 2 s and bursts — the pressure pushes and hurts everything within 8 blocks, the ground shakes and the released form (Pantera, Murciélago or Serpiente) lasts 60 s. Released: Hollow techniques +25%, stronger Gran Rey Cero and the Cero Oscuras. When it ends, the body pays (Weakness, Slowness, Vigor at 25%). Cost: 40% Vigor. Cooldown 5 min.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollowfied_cero_fusio: Hollow augment: the spell gains a CERO — the moment it is cast, a thin beam fires from your mouth (or hand, as an Arrancar) where you look: 22 blocks, pierces every enemy (own damage 3, +1 per Hollow stage, with the spell's power), in your Cero's color. Doesn't apply the spell's effects. Costs 8 mana and +0.4 s cast time; doesn't stack.
Hollow trigger (goes at the start of the spell): the slot fires BY ITSELF when you devour a soul, aiming at the nearest enemy — and grows stronger the bigger the soul: +1% power per Soul from that kill (up to +100%: bosses and players). Each fire spends 1 stored Soul. Pressing the slot key doesn't cast. At most once per second.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.became_tip.5: • Hollow Wheel (default H): the other techniques. Everything is explained in the Hollow tab of the B menu.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.tech_silence: Silenced: your Reiatsu won't come out.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.gran_rey_sho: The blood hasn't mixed into the Cero yet — hold longer.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.oscuras_read: The charge darkens... Cero Oscuras ready — release!
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.negacion_sta: Negación: the light surrounds you — nothing can touch you.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.devour_trigg: Soul devoured — the spell fires by itself (+%s%%)
This spell only fires by itself, when you devour a soul.
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.cmd_tech_fai: Couldn't use that technique now (invalid id, no archetype, or nullified).
message.isekai_mahou.hollow.cmd_glyphs: Hollow class glyphs learned: Fused Cero and On Devouring a Soul.
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.tech_keys: Key %s = Hollow Instinct (tap, hold, sneaking, sprinting). Key %s = Hollow Wheel. No spell building needed.
screen.isekai_mahou.hollow.wheel_tip: Aim and release the key · click · 1–7 · right click closes
